usage.total_tokens_derivation: Codex CLI reported input_tokens and output_tokens; this fixture uses input_tokens + output_tokens as total_tokens and records cached/reasoning splits separately.

checks.label: The answer gives a plain closeout/stop action.
The reasons explain the frontier, acceptance evidence, and why another attempt is not authorized.
The resume pointer names attempt-f-closeout-candidate as the current/frontier state.
The acceptance status and remaining work are explicit.
The next fields are complete and at least one direct evidence reference lets a reader continue.
The boundary plainly says this is decision support, not approval/release/deployment/compliance.
